newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Korea governor says won level acceptable.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea governor says won level acceptable.

text.p: Bank of Korea Governor Kyung Shik Lee said on Thursday that the current level of the won was acceptable and the central bank's focus was on currency stability.
"I think the current level is acceptable so I want it (the won) to be stable," he told Reuters Financial Television.
Referring to the recent failure of Hanbo Steel Corp and its impact on the financial markets in Korea the Governor said, "The Hanbo problem is not a fundamental one."
"The effect on the economy (from Hanbo) is not so serious," he added.
"Other measures are not necessary...the Hanbo scandal does not need any extra money," he added.
